scope: Bounded worker-crash recovery during live artifact generation.

forcedFailure.mechanism: The host starts a real worker request, then invalidates that worker before the event loop resumes; the pending request rejects.

limits: This proves recovery after a forced worker failure only when a later schema edit triggers new analysis.
The last-known String type remains visible during the failed refresh; this does not prove a no-stale interval or cancellation/supersession safety.
This is bounded evidence only; issue #38 and live-typing gate #42 remain open.
